parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, typically small and flat for easy pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is pressed by the user to pump liquid from the container through the nozzle. It acts as the actuator of the pump mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head connects the pressing lid to the pump mechanism and nozzle, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal tube to the outlet when the lid is pressed, ensuring proper flow direction.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but transfers motion from the pressing lid to the internal pump components.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, typically made of polyethylene plastic, with a cubic or rounded shape.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid (soap, lotion, sanitizer, etc.) and supports the pump assembly on top.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the stable base of the dispenser.
